```yaml
name: Push Kubernetes Manifests to GHCR

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'overlays/x86/**'

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

jobs:
  push-manifests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Create temporary Dockerfile
        run: |
          mkdir -p overlays/x86
          cat <<'EOF' > overlays/x86/Dockerfile
          FROM scratch
          COPY . .
          EOF

      - name: Log in to GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push OCI artifact
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: overlays/x86
          file: overlays/x86/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: ghcr.io/fabito/htk8s/overlays/x86:${{ github.sha }}
          platforms: linux/amd64

      - name: Clean up temporary Dockerfile
        run: rm -f overlays/x86/Dockerfile
```
